artifacts.summary: 7-phase plan replacing three hand-maintained runtime-file enumerations with a single-source lib, closing five class gaps and demonstrating the acceptance behaviour via a new regression test.

memory_candidates.content: When one lint script is itself one of several hand-maintained enumerations of a class it exists to police, the enumerations drift in mutually inconsistent ways and the lint goes blind to whole sub-classes. Diagnostic signal that this has already happened: the two internal lists of the SAME script disagree (e.g. a probe list covers a member the tracked-file regex list does not), and downstream test fixtures that claim to 'mirror' a canonical doc block have silently drifted ahead of it. The proportionate remedy is a single sourced bash lib holding one record per class member (pattern + probe path + regex + type flag), with every mechanical consumer deriving from it; a markdown block that cannot 'source' the lib is pinned instead by a doc-sync assertion inside the regression test. Precedent in this repo: scripts/lib/task-reference-patterns.sh, sourced by both a lint and a write-time hook.
